image_description: A black, wedge-shaped stage monitor loudspeaker system. It features a dual-woofer configuration with two large circular drivers at the bottom and three smaller high-frequency horn/tweeter modules arranged in an arc above them. The front is covered by a protective metal grille. The brand name 'Triton' is visible in white text on the upper right section of the grille.
